'''Janese''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. She once teamed up with the [[Duros/Legends|Duros]] [[Archaeologist/Legends|archaeologist]] [[Levat]] and the [[Chiss/Legends|Chiss]] [[Big game hunter/Legends|big-game hunter]] [[Kres'keth'errylu]] to explore a [[Unidentified temple (Rhen Var)|temple]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Rhen Var/Legends|Rhen Var]].
